criteria.label: Comprehension
descriptors: Identify the main request with support.
Identify the main request and some relevant detail.
Interpret the request and relevant constraints accurately.
Interpret nuance, priorities and implied needs with evidence.

criteria.label: Vocabulary & accuracy
descriptors: Use isolated words or patterns; errors often obscure meaning.
Use relevant vocabulary; some errors affect meaning.
Use varied appropriate language; errors rarely affect meaning.
Use precise vocabulary and flexible structures with consistent control.

criteria.label: Communicative effectiveness
descriptors: Partially address the purpose; substantial clarification needed.
Communicate the main message but omit a useful next step.
Fulfil the purpose and give clear, workable next steps.
Respond flexibly, justify choices and resolve uncertainty.

criteria.label: Organization & clarity
descriptors: Ideas are difficult to follow.
Some sequence is clear; links need development.
Sequence ideas logically with useful linking expressions.
Present a concise, coherent response suited to the format.

criteria.label: Audience & professionalism
descriptors: Tone or format often mismatches the guest's needs.
Generally polite; register or detail needs adjustment.
Use respectful tone, clear choices and appropriate boundaries.
Balance empathy, professional clarity and guest autonomy.

criteria.label: Intercultural understanding
descriptors: Make unsupported assumptions about the guest.
Recognize that preferences differ; sometimes generalize.
Ask about individual needs and avoid stereotypes.
Explore preferences sensitively and explain choices without generalizing.

sourceSlides.text:
落地签太方便了。
“太+形容词”（+了）
表示程度高，肯定形式常和“了”连用，多用于赞叹。
太+ คำคุณศัพท์  ใช้ในประโยคบอกเล่า แสดงถึงระดับสูงกว่าปกติ ท้ายประโยคตามด้วย 了มักใช้ชมเชยหรือชื่นชม
①手机太方便了！
②泰国太漂亮了！
③我太高兴了！
太好了
语法注释 ไวยากรณ์

小爱：好的，我在机场等你。

discussion.prompt: Who has arrived, and who is still travelling? Cite evidence.
discussion.guide: 小爱 has reached Thailand; 佳佳 says 我马上到机场. Do not merge their timelines.

body: 小乐：您好，这是我的落地签。
签证官：请给我护照和登机牌。
小乐：好的。
签证官：可以了，欢迎您!
小乐：谢谢，落地签太方便了！

discussion.prompt: Which lines show request, completion and welcome?
discussion.guide: 请给我… is a request; 可以了 marks completion in this exchange; 欢迎您 welcomes the visitor.

patterns.title: 太…了 / 不太…
patterns.explanation: 太 + adjective + 了 expresses a strong reaction here. 不太 + adjective softens a negative assessment; the source examples do not add this final 了.
patterns.pitfall: 不太远 is not the same as 很近; it softens the negative without giving a precise distance.
patterns.application: Give an enthusiastic personal reaction, then a measured service description.

patterns.title: 到 / 马上 / 等一下
patterns.explanation: 到 reports reaching a place; 马上 places an event in the near future in these examples. Wait expressions manage the interaction rather than promise a precise number of minutes.
patterns.pitfall: 我马上到 does not mean I am already there. Do not invent a precise wait time.
patterns.application: Send an arrival update and one polite waiting request.

questions.prompt: At the end of dialogue one, where does 小爱 say she will wait?
questions.explanation: She says 我在机场等你; 佳佳 is still going to the airport.

questions.prompt: Which detail does 不太远 leave unresolved?
questions.explanation: 不太远 evaluates distance but gives no route or measurement.

options.text: 工作人员已经回答问题。

questions.prompt: Which documents does the officer request in this textbook exchange?
questions.explanation: 请给我护照和登机牌 is the source line. This is retrieval from a dialogue, not a current document checklist.

questions.prompt: Complete with the two-character source wait expression: 请____，我马上来。
questions.explanation: 稍等 is the polite brief-wait expression on slide 5. It does not specify a duration.

questions.prompt: Which source collocation means to complete arrival-visa formalities?
questions.explanation: 办 collocates with formalities such as 办护照 and 办落地签 on slide 8.

questions.prompt: Use the source softening pattern: 不____远。（one character）
questions.explanation: 不太远 softens a negative assessment. 太 goes between 不 and the adjective in this pattern.

questions.prompt: Which update indicates arrival is imminent rather than completed?
questions.explanation: 马上 marks an imminent event here; the other two place the speaker at the airport.

questions.prompt: A visitor hears “在那儿” but still looks unsure. Which follow-up advances communication?
questions.explanation: Clarify the reference point. Do not turn the source language exchange into eligibility advice.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, compare the two speakers’ locations and timing in dialogue one. Explain why 马上 cannot be treated as 已经.
tasks.model: 小爱说“我到泰国啦”，说明她已经到达。佳佳说“我马上到机场”，说明她还在去机场的途中。小爱会在机场等她。因此，“马上”表示很快会发生，不能据此说佳佳已经到了机场。两人所在的阶段不同。
successCriteria: Distinguish completed arrival from an imminent arrival.
Support the timeline with two quotations.
scaffold: Quote a short source phrase, then explain what it shows.
Separate a statement from an inference or an unanswered question.
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character arrival communication plan with a missed-meeting contingency. Justify how your wording avoids false reassurance.

tasks.title: An airport meeting message
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters to a visitor whose exact meeting point is unclear. Welcome them, explain which source speaker has arrived, ask for a visible landmark, state where to wait after mutual confirmation, and explain how you will update them. Use 请问, 等 and 马上 appropriately. Do not invent a real airport route.
tasks.model: 您好，欢迎您来泰国！您说已经到机场了，我想先确认一下您现在的位置。请问您能看见哪个柜台，或者附近有什么明显的标志？您可以把标志的文字告诉我，我们再一起确认见面的地方。确认以后，请您在约定的地点稍等。如果我说“马上到”，意思是我还在路上，并不是已经站在您的旁边。到达后我会再给您消息；如果位置有变化，也请告诉我。这样我们就不会因为“在那儿”不够清楚而走错地方。谢谢您的配合。
successCriteria: Clarify a meeting point without inventing a route.
Use time expressions accurately.
Close with a clear next action.
scaffold: 您好，欢迎…；请问您现在…？
我马上…；确认以后，请…
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character arrival communication plan with a missed-meeting contingency. Justify how your wording avoids false reassurance.

tasks.title: Find each other at arrivals
tasks.prompt: Visitor: you have arrived but cannot identify the meeting point. Host: you are still travelling and must clarify a shared landmark. Round two: the visitor moves to another location. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

body: 素察：小爱，你来曼谷几天了？
小爱：我来曼谷三天了。
素察：你和佳佳都去哪儿玩了？
小爱：我们去了大皇宫、卧佛寺和安帕瓦水上市场。

discussion.prompt: How does the question with 都 shape the reply?
discussion.guide: It prompts a list; 小爱 names all three places rather than a yes/no answer.

patterns.title: 来 / 去
patterns.explanation: The source contrasts movement toward a speaker/reference point (来) with movement away (去). The same trip can be described differently by speakers at different locations.
patterns.pitfall: Do not choose the verb solely from an English translation; establish the reference point.
patterns.application: Describe the same trip as visitor and host.

patterns.title: A 离 B 远 / 近
patterns.explanation: 离 relates two places in a distance description. State the reference places explicitly when the listener cannot infer them.
examples: 大皇宫离你的酒店不远。
patterns.pitfall: 不远 is not a measured route or a promise of a short journey.
patterns.application: Explain a relative location, then ask for the actual starting point.

patterns.title: 都 + question word
patterns.explanation: In the source’s questions, 都 invites a fuller list of experiences or places. It does not simply mean every person in every use.
patterns.pitfall: Keep the question word; a complete answer should respond to the requested list.
patterns.application: Interview a partner about places visited and summarize the list.

tasks.model: 第五页的小爱说“我想去”，是在表达愿望，不能说明已经去过。第十一页她说“我们去了”，是在回顾三天里的活动。两段都提到大皇宫、卧佛寺和安帕瓦水上市场，但是时间和交际目的不同。

tasks.title: A destination enquiry reply
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters to a visitor considering the three source destinations. Ask about interests and time, clarify the difference between two places, use one 离 sentence explicitly framed as the source situation, and propose how to choose an itinerary.
tasks.model: 您好！您想去大皇宫、卧佛寺，还是安帕瓦水上市场？这三个地方都出现在课文里，但大皇宫和卧佛寺并不是同一个地方。请问您更想了解建筑，还是逛市场、看看当地生活？您明天有多少时间，也希望留多少休息时间？课文说大皇宫离客人的酒店不远，但您的出发地点可能不同。我们可以先确认酒店位置和您的兴趣，再核实路线与开放安排。请把最想去的地方告诉我，我再整理一个方便您比较的行程建议。
successCriteria: Ask for interests before ordering an itinerary.
Distinguish destinations correctly.
Explain a source distance without turning it into a live promise.

discussion.guide: 两个房间一共 is a total for two rooms. Nights, room category, tax and equal individual prices are not specified.

body: 服务员：您好!我是服务员，可以进来吗？

服务员：这是您的行李。

discussion.prompt: Which words show that entry is requested? Why does the guest’s next turn matter?
discussion.guide: 可以进来吗 requests permission; 请进 grants it. A professional extension also allows the guest to delay or decline.

patterns.title: 到 + place + 了
patterns.explanation: This source pattern reports arrival or a newly reached situation. Contrast 去酒店 (go to the hotel) and 在酒店 (be at the hotel). 了 is not a general past-tense marker.
patterns.pitfall: In this target pattern put 了 after the place. 到了酒店 is possible in other constructions and is not universally wrong.
patterns.application: Report that you have arrived, then state where the guest is now. Explain the change in meaning.

patterns.title: 一共: specify the unit of a total
patterns.explanation: 一共 introduces a total across stated rooms, people or items. Slide 9 gives a combined total for two rooms, without specifying nights or a nightly rate.
patterns.pitfall: Do not infer equal prices or included charges from a combined total.
patterns.application: Clarify the total with 不是…，是…. Ask about one detail not supplied.

patterns.title: 可以…吗？ / 请…
patterns.explanation: 可以…吗？ asks whether an action is permitted here. 请 makes a request or invitation more courteous. Respecting a refusal is a supplementary pragmatic extension of the source.
examples: 服务员：您好!我是服务员，可以进来吗？
patterns.pitfall: A polite request is not itself consent. Wait for an answer and acknowledge 现在不方便.
patterns.application: Make a luggage-delivery request and respond naturally when the guest declines.

questions.prompt: Which phrase states the purpose of the guests’ visit?

questions.prompt: Which interpretation of slide 9 is supported?
questions.explanation: 一共 marks a combined total. Nights and individual rates are not given; the amount is a source training scenario.

tasks.title: Two audiences, one clear arrival
tasks.prompt: Write 180–260 Chinese characters in two labeled parts: a guest welcome message confirming the training scenario (two rooms, 3,000 baht total), explaining room cards and asking about luggage help; then an internal handover identifying confirmed and unresolved details. tasks.model:

Ask permission before action.
Differentiate guest and colleague audiences.

patterns.title: 怎么 + action
patterns.explanation: 怎么 asks about how an action is done. The verb determines whether the question concerns a route, booking method or charges.
patterns.pitfall: 怎么走 is not the same question as 怎么收费. Match the answer to the requested action.
patterns.application: Ask three distinct questions about a trip.

patterns.title: 先…，然后…
patterns.explanation: 先 introduces the first step; 然后 connects the next. Keep left/right and the starting point explicit.
patterns.pitfall: Changing the sequence can change the route. The source has no full current street map.
patterns.application: Give a two-stage fictional route and have the listener repeat it.

patterns.title: 去 + place + action
patterns.explanation: The action after the place states the purpose of going. It differs from simply reporting a location.
patterns.pitfall: 去银行 and 在银行 are not interchangeable if the purpose of movement matters.
patterns.application: Combine destination and purpose in two travel plans.

patterns.title: 用 A 换 B
patterns.explanation: 用 identifies the means or currency given; 换 introduces what is obtained. The direction must be clear before discussing an amount.
patterns.pitfall: A request for 一千人民币 specifies the amount of input currency here, not the baht payout.
patterns.application: Clarify a reversed currency request politely.

tasks.title: A clear bank enquiry card
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters for a visitor to show a bank staff member. State the source request for 1,000 renminbi into baht, ask about rate, fee and final payout, and add a brief explanation to the visitor of why these must be confirmed. Do not calculate an invented payout.

给游客的说明：课文中的一千人民币是准备兑换的金额，不是最后收到的泰铢。您可以先去银行询问，再决定是否办理。请同时确认货币方向、手续费和最终金额；如果其中一项不清楚，可以请工作人员再解释一次，不必因为担心说错中文而匆忙同意。

patterns.title: A 还是 B？
patterns.explanation: 还是 introduces alternatives in a question, including an embedded question such as 不知道…还是….
patterns.pitfall: Do not replace 还是 with 或者 mechanically in this direct choice-question pattern.
patterns.application: Ask about destination and transport as separate choices.

patterns.title: 从 A 到 B / 坐… / 骑…
patterns.explanation: 从…到… frames origin and destination. The source uses 坐 with taxis, planes and trains, and 骑 with motorcycles.
examples: 从这里到玛雅商场有多远？
patterns.pitfall: The source describes one speaker’s earlier journey and example times; neither establishes universal preferences.
patterns.application: Describe a past journey, then ask about a proposed one.

tasks.title: A choice with competing priorities
tasks.prompt: Traveller: prefer a short trip but dislike one proposed mode. Adviser: ask for priorities and explain the source comparison. Round two: add luggage or a second traveller. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

patterns.title: Place + 有 + people / things
patterns.explanation: An existential 有 sentence introduces what is present in a place. Put the location first when describing a scene.
patterns.pitfall: 有 introduces existence; 是 identifies something. Do not treat a present-tense description as a live event listing.
patterns.application: Describe a market scene with two location-first sentences.

patterns.title: 我觉得… / 好听、好吃、有趣
patterns.explanation: 我觉得 marks an evaluation from a speaker’s viewpoint. Sensory words describe different kinds of response.
patterns.pitfall: A personal preference is not a claim that all visitors will enjoy the activity.
patterns.application: Separate a scene description from your personal response.

tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, distinguish two market observations from a personal opinion. Explain why this matters when recommending a visit.
tasks.model: 夜市有很多人、有人唱歌，是课文对当时情景的描述。“我觉得榴莲很好吃”则是个人评价。推荐行程时可以介绍这些内容，但不能推断所有游客都喜欢热闹或榴莲，还应该询问对方的兴趣。

tasks.title: A small destination guide
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters introducing a market visit and a temple option using source language. Include two 有 sentences, one explicitly personal evaluation, a question about visitor interests, and a reasoned choice. Do not invent labels for the image-only fruit slide.
tasks.model: 课文中的周末夜市有很多人，也有水果和唱歌的活动。说话人觉得夜市有趣，还想尝榴莲。这些细节能帮助我们想象当时的气氛，但每位游客的感受可能不同。清迈还有很多寺庙，可以作为另一个参观主题。您更喜欢逛热闹的市场，还是安静地观察建筑？我觉得先了解您的兴趣，比直接推荐最热闹的地方更有用。如果您想尝水果，我们可以先问问您喜欢的味道；如果更想参观寺庙，就先了解具体地点和安排，再选择适合的时间。

A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

patterns.title: Adjective + 不 + adjective
patterns.explanation: A-not-A presents opposite possibilities: 累不累, 冷不冷. In these neutral questions do not add 吗 as another yes/no marker.
patterns.pitfall: Do not ask 累不累吗 in this target pattern. A question is not an assumption that the person is unfit.
patterns.application: Ask about a route and a person’s preferences.

patterns.title: 有点儿冷 / 不太…
patterns.explanation: 有点儿冷 indicates a slight degree of cold, often with an inconvenient implication. It differs from 很冷. 不太… softens a negative degree judgement.
examples: 有点儿冷，带一件大衣吧。
patterns.pitfall: A speaker’s description of yesterday is not tomorrow’s forecast.
patterns.application: Respond to a comfort concern with a clarification rather than a guarantee.

tasks.title: A pre-hike conversation brief
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters for a traveller considering the source hike. Ask two A-not-A questions, acknowledge the source coat suggestion, distinguish past impressions from future conditions, and offer a next step based on the traveller’s preferences.

patterns.title: V一V / VV
patterns.explanation: Short action-verb reduplication can suggest trying or doing something briefly and soften a suggestion. It is not a mechanical transformation for every verb.
patterns.pitfall: Do not treat 问一问 as confirmation of a result; it only announces checking.
patterns.application: Soften a suggestion and state a checking action.

patterns.title: 两份 / 菜单、账单、买单
patterns.explanation: 两份 specifies two portions. 菜单 is the menu, 账单 the bill, and 买单 the act of settling it in this context.
examples: 这是您的账单，一共160泰铢。
patterns.pitfall: The source total is not labelled per portion. Keep item, quantity and total distinct.
patterns.application: Confirm an order and explain the bill without inventing prices.

questions.prompt: How many portions are ordered in dialogue one?
questions.explanation: 来两份 follows the recommendation of Thai-style stir-fried noodles.

questions.prompt: What does the server do when asked whether the noodles are ready?
questions.explanation: The server offers to check; the actual completion status is not given.

questions.prompt: Which amount is presented as the bill total?
questions.explanation: Slide 8 says 一共160泰铢. Slide 7 has a separate illustrative amount.

questions.prompt: Which item helps a guest choose dishes before ordering?
questions.explanation: 菜单 supports selection; 账单 states charges after consumption in the scenario.

questions.prompt: Complete: 我们点了两____炒面。
questions.explanation: 份 is the source measure word for portions.

questions.prompt: Which expression softens a suggestion to try the dish?
questions.explanation: 尝一尝 uses the source reduplication pattern.

questions.prompt: Complete with the source reduplicated action: 稍等，我去____。
questions.explanation: 问一问 announces checking with someone. 问问 is also a corresponding reduplicated form.

questions.prompt: A diner asks about an ingredient not specified in the course. Which reply is appropriate?
questions.explanation: An absent ingredient list is not evidence of absence. Confirm the actual request with the relevant staff.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, explain what the server confirms in dialogue two and why a guessed answer would be a problem.
tasks.model: 服务员说“我去问一问”，只确认自己会去了解情况，并没有说炒面已经做好，也没有给出等待时间。如果没有询问就保证马上上菜，可能让客人误解。更好的做法是核实以后再清楚地回复。

tasks.title: An order and a delay reply
tasks.prompt: Write a 160–240-character Chinese restaurant exchange with labels for guest/server. Recommend the source dish gently, confirm two portions, handle a delay by checking, and present the source bill total of 160 baht as training data. Include one follow-up question.
tasks.model:
服务员：您好，这是菜单。您想了解本店的特色菜吗？可以尝一尝课文里的泰式炒面。
客人：好的，来两份。我想先问一下，如果有饮食方面的要求，可以请厨房确认吗？
服务员：可以，请先告诉我具体需要了解什么，我去问一问，再把结果告诉您。
客人：炒面做好了吗？
服务员：请稍等，我先确认现在的情况，不随便答应上菜时间。
客人：谢谢，我们最后怎么买单？
服务员：用餐后会给您账单。本次课文练习的总额是一百六十泰铢，两个部分的金额与份数都要说清楚，实际消费则以确认后的账单为准。
successCriteria: Confirm recommendation and quantity separately.
Use a checking response instead of a guessed result.
Distinguish menu, bill and settling payment.
scaffold: 您想…？可以尝一尝…
两份…，对吗？
请稍等，我去问一问。

tasks.title: The dish is taking longer
tasks.prompt: Diner: order two portions, then ask whether they are ready. Server: acknowledge and check. Round two: the diner has a time constraint; agree what to confirm without inventing a completion time. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.
tasks.model:
客人：我们还要等多久？我们一会儿要走。
服务员：我明白您有时间安排。我先问一下厨房现在的情况，再回来告诉您可以怎样选择。
客人：请先确认能不能调整。
服务员：好的，我会把您的需要一起问清楚。
successCriteria: Handle a delay with empathy and a concrete checking action.
Adapt to a time constraint without an unsupported promise.
scaffold: Diner: add a time constraint in round two.
Server: acknowledge → clarify → check → report.

patterns.title: 几号 / 几点 / 几个小时
patterns.explanation: 几号 asks date; 几点 asks clock time; 几个小时 asks duration. Context determines the relevant unit.
patterns.pitfall: The “under ten” description is a tendency for some count enquiries, not a strict limit on clock/date values.
patterns.application: Ask three questions that distinguish date, clock time and duration.

patterns.title: 大概 / 出发 / 上飞机
patterns.explanation: 大概 marks approximation. 出发 begins a journey; 上飞机/登机 is boarding. These are distinct schedule events.
patterns.pitfall: Do not infer takeoff, airport arrival or a safe transfer buffer from the source’s simplified times.
patterns.application: Prepare an event timeline and label unknowns.

questions.prompt: Which date is proposed for going to Phuket?
questions.explanation: 十号 answers 几号; the others are clock time and duration.

questions.prompt: Which event is proposed for 1 p.m.?
questions.explanation: 下午一点出发 is the transfer proposal.

questions.prompt: What is said about three o’clock?
questions.explanation: The crew member answers the boarding question with 三点; takeoff is not stated.

questions.prompt: Which source word makes the four-hour duration approximate?
questions.explanation: 大概 qualifies the duration estimate.

questions.prompt: Which expression matches 上飞机 in the source vocabulary note?

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, organize the date, departure, duration and boarding information. Identify an event time that is missing.
tasks.model: 课文提出十号去普吉，下午一点出发去机场，三点可以上飞机，飞行时间大概四个小时。不过，出发、登机和起飞不是同一件事，对话没有说明起飞时间，也不能据此算出实际到达时间。
successCriteria: Distinguish date, clock time and duration.
Identify a genuinely unstated event.
scaffold: Quote a short source phrase, then explain what it shows.
Separate a statement from an inference or an unanswered question.
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character handover comparing original and revised teacher-supplied flight notices; use a timeline and explain dependencies.

tasks.title: A transfer confirmation message
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters to a visitor, clearly labeling the source information as a training itinerary. Distinguish the date, 1 p.m. departure, 3 o’clock boarding and approximate duration. Ask for missing flight details and explain the next confirmation step.
tasks.model: 送机安排练习：课文建议十号去普吉，下午一点出发去机场，三点可以上飞机，飞行时间大概四个小时。请注意，一点是出发时间，三点是登机时间，不是同一个事件；“大概”也表示这只是估计。请问您实际乘坐哪一天的航班，航班信息确认了吗？还请告诉我出发地点，以便我们核实交通安排。我们不能把课文里的四个小时直接当成真实航程，也不能由登机时间推算起飞时间。确认航空公司的通知和接送条件以后，我会再给您一份标明日期、时间及待确认事项的消息。
successCriteria: Distinguish all four time concepts.
Ask for missing details before confirming.
Present a coherent timeline.

tasks.title: Resolve a timing misunderstanding
tasks.prompt: Traveller: confuse the departure time with boarding. Coordinator: clarify the event labels and ask the date. Round two: the boarding notice changes; summarize what now requires rechecking. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. patterns.title: 真… / 太…了
patterns.explanation: 真 expresses a sincere strong reaction in these examples; 太…了 also signals a high degree or reaction. Neither makes a subjective description objective.
patterns.pitfall: Avoid adding 了 mechanically after every 真 sentence.
patterns.application: Rewrite an enthusiastic description as a measured visitor recommendation.

patterns.title: 吧 / 试试 / 逛逛
patterns.explanation: 吧 softens an invitation or proposal here. Repeated action verbs such as 试试 and 逛逛 suggest trying or browsing.
examples: 我们一起在沙滩上走走吧！
patterns.pitfall: An invitation should leave room to decline; enthusiasm does not establish activity suitability.
patterns.application: Offer two alternatives and ask a preference.

tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, identify one destination detail and two subjective reactions. Explain how a responsible description would use them.
tasks.model: 课文把地点说成巴东海滩，并提到旁边的江西冷商场。“真漂亮”和“真舒服”是说话人的感受，不代表所有游客的体验。介绍时可以说明这些感受来自课文，再问游客喜欢散步还是逛商场。

tasks.title: A destination guide with choice
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters for a small destination guide. Use the source beach and shopping context, two degree expressions and an invitation. Distinguish personal impressions from facts, ask interests, and include an alternative for someone who declines the water activity.
tasks.model: 目的地小记：课文里的巴东海滩让说话人觉得“真漂亮”，晚上的海风也让她觉得舒服。海滩旁边的江西冷商场提供了另一个讨论主题，可以把散步和逛街作为不同选择。您更想看看海景，还是到商场走走？我们可以先听听您的兴趣，再了解当天的安排。课文中有人想试试海上摩托车，但觉得好玩不等于适合每个人，也不能说明今天的活动条件。如果您不想参加水上活动，我们也可以只讨论散步或购物的方案。请告诉我您希望怎样安排时间，再一起作决定。
successCriteria: Offer a choice using attributed impressions.
Use degree language without unsupported superlatives.
Respect an activity refusal.

您更想…，还是…？
不参加…的话，也可以…

tasks.title: An invitation that leaves a choice
tasks.prompt: Adviser: describe the beach and suggest an activity. Visitor: prefer looking at the sea to water sports. Round two: ask for a shopping alternative. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

patterns.title: 多少 / 几
patterns.explanation: 多少 asks quantity or amount; 几 commonly expects a small count and takes a measure word before a counted noun. Fixed questions such as 几点 and 几号 also follow conventional patterns.
patterns.pitfall: “Under ten” is not a universal mathematical rule for every use of 几. Count units such as 杯 or 瓶 when asking about water.
patterns.application: Ask separately about count, volume and price.

patterns.title: 件 / 合适 / 试一试
patterns.explanation: 件 is a measure word for clothing/items; 合适 describes suitability or fit. 试一试 invites trying without requiring purchase.
patterns.pitfall: 漂亮 and 合适 answer different concerns. A pleasing appearance does not establish fit.
patterns.application: Clarify a shopper’s fit and budget before recommending.

patterns.title: Sentence-final 了 / 变得…了
patterns.explanation: The source uses sentence-final 了 to mark a new situation or change. 变得 explicitly highlights becoming. It does not simply mark every sentence as past tense.
patterns.pitfall: 街上很热闹 describes a state; 变得热闹了 highlights a change from before.
patterns.application: Give a before/now update with a consequence.

patterns.title: 快…了 / 已经…了 / 该…了
patterns.explanation: 快…了 indicates an approaching event; 已经 marks a reached state; 该…了 suggests it is time for an action in this context.
examples: 已经晚上九点了，我们该回去了。
patterns.pitfall: A personal return suggestion is not a universal curfew.
patterns.application: Explain why you suggest changing a plan.

tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, trace the evening’s development through three time/change expressions and explain the return decision.

tasks.title: An evening update and return plan
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters to companions at an evening market. Describe how the scene has changed, explain a return proposal with a reason, politely decline an offered ride and offer an alternative. Ask for agreement rather than announcing a universal rule.
tasks.model: 大家好！我们刚到普吉镇的时候，夜市还没有开始，现在街上变得热闹了。课文里的小爱到了晚上九点，觉得该回酒店了；这个时间是她的安排，不是所有游客都必须遵守的规定。如果我们也准备回去，先确认大家还有没有想完成的事情。谢谢您愿意开车送我们，不过我们打算自己打车回酒店。请问大家觉得这个安排怎么样？如果有人还想多逛一会儿，我们可以先讨论见面的地点和联系办法，再决定是否分开行动。请把最终决定再说一遍，避免有人以为计划没有改变。
successCriteria: Explain a changing situation and a reasoned return proposal.
Decline courteously and offer an alternative.
Confirm agreement with companions.

tasks.title: An evening plan changes
tasks.prompt: Companion A: propose returning because the evening has progressed. Companion B: offer a lift, then say you want to stay longer. Negotiate a revised agreement without pressure. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

patterns.title: 打算 / 什么时候 / 有空儿
patterns.explanation: 打算 introduces an intention or plan; 什么时候 asks timing; 有空儿 asks availability. A plan is not a confirmed reservation.
patterns.pitfall: 下星期 and 下周末 are related but not identical time scopes; clarify the actual day.
patterns.application: Ask timing, availability and intended activity as separate questions.

patterns.title: …，怎么样？
patterns.explanation: Placed after a proposal, 怎么样 asks for the other person’s view. In other contexts it can ask about a condition or experience.
examples: 我们明天早上一起去看日出，怎么样？
patterns.pitfall: A proposal with 怎么样 invites an answer; it does not establish consent.
patterns.application: Make a suggestion, acknowledge a refusal and offer an alternative.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, distinguish intention, availability and agreement in the two dialogues. Explain one clarification still needed for a real plan.
tasks.model: “打算”说明想做什么，“有空儿”询问时间是否方便，“怎么样”邀请对方表达意见。三者不能互相代替。课文里说下星期和下周末，但实际安排还应该确认具体日期、见面地点，以及大家是否愿意早起。
successCriteria: Separate intention, availability and agreement.
Identify a concrete planning clarification.
scaffold: Quote a short source phrase, then explain what it shows.
Separate a statement from an inference or an unanswered question.
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character itinerary proposal with two alternatives and a short rationale for why each suits a different preference.

tasks.title: An invitation with two possible plans
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters proposing a source-inspired island or sunrise outing. Use 打算, 有空儿 and 怎么样; ask an exact timing question and include an alternative for someone who declines the early start. Distinguish a proposal from a confirmed plan.
tasks.model: 你好！你下周末有空儿吗？课文介绍了苏梅岛，也提到查汶海滩的日出。我想先了解你的兴趣，再一起商量。我们找一个早上去看日出，怎么样？不过，“下周末没有课”不一定表示那个时间没有其他安排，所以还想问问具体哪一天方便，你愿不愿意早起。如果你更希望晚一点出发，我们也可以改成白天散步或另选一个活动，不必为了配合我而答应。现在只是建议，还没有确认日期和交通。等你说说想法以后，我们再核实见面地点、出发方式和当天条件，最后一起确认。
successCriteria: Invite a response with a genuine alternative.
Distinguish proposal from confirmed arrangements.
Clarify exact timing.
scaffold: 你打算…？你有空儿吗？
一起…，怎么样？
如果不方便，也可以…
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character itinerary proposal with two alternatives and a short rationale for why each suits a different preference.

tasks.title: Agree on a plan without pressure
tasks.prompt: Planner: invite a partner on a sunrise outing. Partner: free next weekend but unwilling to start early. Round two: both have different preferred days. Negotiate one workable next step. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.
tasks.model:
甲：我们明天早上看日出，怎么样？
乙：我有空儿，可是不想太早起床。
甲：那我们换个时间或活动吧。你具体哪一天方便？
乙：星期天比较合适，我们先比较几个方案。
甲：好的，这只是建议，我们等信息确认以后再一起决定具体安排。
successCriteria: Negotiate timing and activity through a genuine invitation.
Acknowledge a refusal without equating it with disinterest.
scaffold: Planner: intention → availability → proposal.
Partner: separate free time from desired activity.

patterns.title: A 比 B + adjective (+ difference)
patterns.explanation: 比 compares the same relevant dimension across two items. A stated difference such as 一点儿 narrows the comparison.
patterns.pitfall: Do not add 很 before the adjective in this basic 比 pattern. Neutral comparisons are used for practice; source body-size examples remain in Sources.
patterns.application: Compare two restaurants using a specified criterion.

patterns.title: A 没有 B + adjective
patterns.explanation: This states A is not as adjective as B. Maintain the comparison dimension when reversing it.
examples: 椰子汁没有芒果汁好喝。
patterns.pitfall: A negative degree comparison is not the same as saying A lacks B as an object.
patterns.application: Restate a preference comparison using both patterns.

tasks.title: A comparative dining recommendation
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters advising a group. Compare the source restaurant options by proximity, attribute the food/drink preferences to the speaker, ask what matters to this group and summarize the changed drink order. Do not invent prices or ingredients.
tasks.model: 用餐建议：课文中的两家饭店都得到肯定，小爱因为这家比那家近一点儿而选择这家。不过，近只是一个比较标准，您也可能更重视环境、预算或饮食需要。请问这次大家最在意什么？点菜时，佳佳觉得烤猪颈肉比炸鸡好吃，也觉得椰子汁没有芒果汁好喝。这些是她的口味，不表示每个人都要选择同样的菜。对话最后把饮料改成芒果汁，所以记录订单时要保留最后的决定，再确认份数和杯数。如果还有没有说清楚的饮食要求，我们先询问，再向餐厅核实，避免只根据个人推荐替整个小组决定。

patterns.title: Adjective / psychological verb + 极了
patterns.explanation: 极了 follows the descriptive expression and emphasizes a strong degree in these examples. Compare 真… and 太…了 without stacking them mechanically.
examples: 泰国的水灯节浪漫极了。
patterns.pitfall: The order is 浪漫极了, not 极了浪漫. Degree language expresses an evaluation.
patterns.application: Write an enthusiastic reaction and a neutral explanation of the same event.

patterns.title: 听说… / 最…
patterns.explanation: 听说 attributes information to something heard; 最 expresses a superlative within an understood comparison group. Neither alone supplies proof.
examples: 听说清迈的水灯节最美了。
patterns.pitfall: The source speaker’s superlative is an opinion/report, not an audited ranking.
patterns.application: Attribute a festival impression and ask a follow-up.

patterns.title: 用… / 飘着…
patterns.explanation: 用 names materials in the making exchange. 飘着 describes a visible floating state in the source scene.
examples: 水灯是用芭蕉叶、花和蜡烛做的。
晚上天上飘着很多孔明灯，好看极了。
patterns.pitfall: Floating water lanterns and sky lanterns are different objects; do not merge them into one practice.
patterns.application: Explain the source materials without inventing a complete construction method.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, distinguish the two lantern types and explain why “大家都” should not be read as a universal participation rule.
tasks.model: 课文提到放在水上的水灯和飘在天上的孔明灯，两者不能混为一谈。“大家都”是在描述课文中的节日情景，不表示每个地方或每个人都必须这样做。介绍时应该尊重游客选择，并核实具体活动安排。

tasks.title: A festival briefing for a visitor
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters introducing the source celebration. Distinguish water and sky lanterns, name the making materials, attribute one enthusiastic reaction, offer observation as an option and identify what needs local confirmation. Do not supply invented release permissions.
tasks.model: 节日介绍：课文把水灯节描写得“浪漫极了”，并提到两种不同的灯：水灯与孔明灯。水灯的制作材料包括芭蕉叶、花和蜡烛；孔明灯则出现在天上飘着的场景中，不能把两者当成同一项活动。说话人听说清迈的水灯节最美，这是一种被转述的评价，不是统一排名。您更想了解制作材料、观察节日气氛，还是询问可以参与的活动？只看不做也完全可以。具体地点是否安排活动、允许怎样参与，都需要向当地负责人员确认，不能把课文中的“大家都”直接当作今天的规定。
successCriteria: Distinguish lantern types, materials and evaluations.
Attribute enthusiasm and avoid universal participation claims.
Offer a respectful choice and a confirmation step.

tasks.title: A festival question with a choice
tasks.prompt: Visitor: ask what the celebration involves, then say you prefer observing. Interpreter: explain the source, distinguish lantern types and invite questions. Round two: the visitor asks whether release is allowed today. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

patterns.title: Verb + 过
patterns.explanation: 过 after a verb marks experience in the source questions and statements. A negative experiential answer commonly uses 没有…过. The new negative example is an editorial teaching extension.
patterns.pitfall: Experiential 过 does not specify an exact event date. Do not replace every past-time statement with 过.
patterns.application: Ask about travel experience, then ask a separate follow-up about time.

patterns.title: A 和 B 一样 / 不一样
patterns.explanation: 一样 compares similarity on a specified dimension; 不一样 states a difference. Keep the dimension explicit rather than comparing entire cultures as if uniform.
examples: 这个杯子的颜色和那个杯子不一样。
patterns.pitfall: A similarity in one feature does not mean every feature or person is the same.
patterns.application: Compare greeting contexts without judging one as better.

patterns.title: 可以教我…吗？ / …一点儿
patterns.explanation: 可以教我…吗？ asks for instruction. 高一点儿 expresses a small relative adjustment in the source hand-position explanation.
examples: 不一样，对老师手要举高一点儿。
patterns.pitfall: The text is not a substitute for a qualified person demonstrating a gesture. Physical practice is optional.
patterns.application: Ask for an explanation or demonstration, then confirm understanding.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, distinguish the two senses of 见面礼 and explain one risk of inferring a guest’s preference from nationality.
tasks.model: “见面礼”可以指初次见面送的礼物，也可以指见面时的礼节，要根据语境判断。课文比较鞠躬礼和合十礼，但国籍不能说明每位客人的习惯。接待时最好先观察、询问，并尊重个人选择。
successCriteria: Explain both senses with context.
Identify a stereotype and a practical alternative.
scaffold: Quote a short source phrase, then explain what it shows.
Separate a statement from an inference or an unanswered question.
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character intercultural reflection comparing one source greeting with a practice you know. Explain variation without ranking cultures.

tasks.title: A greeting briefing for a new colleague
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters briefing a colleague. Summarize the source customs as descriptions, distinguish relationship/context from nationality, include an experiential question and a respectful enquiry about preferred address or greeting. Do not require a physical gesture.
tasks.model: 同事简报：课文介绍了鞠躬礼和合十礼，也说明对老师与对同学的做法有不同。这些描述可以帮助我们开始了解礼节，却不能作为判断每位客人的固定规则。“见面礼”还有初次见面赠送礼物的意思，要结合语境理解。交流时可以问“您以前来过泰国吗”，听听对方的经历，再礼貌地确认“请问怎么称呼您比较合适”。如果对方愿意，也可以询问是否希望了解当地的问候方式。客人只想口头打招呼时，我们同样尊重，不要求模仿手势，也不因为国籍就推断对方一定喜欢哪种礼节。
successCriteria: Compare source customs without prescribing individual behavior.
Explain both senses of 见面礼.

②妹妹越来越漂亮了。
③我越来越喜欢说汉语了。

discussion.prompt: Which lines describe a trend, an event claim and an identity comparison?
discussion.guide: 越来越多 is a trend; 三天 is the source duration claim; 越来越像泰国人 invites critique of a broad identity comparison.

patterns.title: 越来越 + adjective / psychological verb
patterns.explanation: 越来越 describes a degree changing over time. A static impression alone does not prove a trend.
examples: 我越来越喜欢说汉语了。
patterns.pitfall: Avoid adding 比 inside this pattern. 越来越多 is not the same structure as 比昨天多.
patterns.application: Describe a supplied before/after observation, then a personal learning trend.

patterns.title: 呢 / 吧 / 吗 in context
patterns.explanation: The source contrasts 呢 in an ongoing-state or emphatic line, 吧 in a suggestion/guess, and 吗 in a yes/no question. Function depends on the sentence, not a single English equivalent.
patterns.pitfall: Do not interchange the particles mechanically. 泼水节有三天呢 is a source claim, not a live festival schedule.
patterns.application: Change a statement into a question and an invitation, explaining the tone.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, explain why 越来越像泰国人 is not an appropriate test of someone’s cultural belonging. Use the source as a discussion point rather than a rule.
tasks.model: 佳佳用“越来越像泰国人”表达亲近感，但参加打水仗不能决定一个人的身份，也不能说明所有泰国人都喜欢同样的活动。我们可以说对方越来越熟悉节日，或越来越喜欢交流，避免把文化归属和一种行为联系起来。
successCriteria: Identify and thoughtfully reframe an identity generalization.
Support the critique with a source phrase.
scaffold: Quote a short source phrase, then explain what it shows.
Separate a statement from an inference or an unanswered question.
tasks.challenge: Write a 300–400-character event interpretation comparing two fictional observations over time. Explain how you know a trend exists and how your language avoids cultural stereotypes.

tasks.title: A festival update with participation choices
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters for a visitor update. Describe the source scene and one developing trend, distinguish reported duration from a current schedule, ask about participation, and rephrase the identity comparison respectfully. Use 越来越 twice.
tasks.model: 活动小记：课文描述宋干节时，街上越来越热闹，泼水的人也越来越多。小爱觉得玩得开心，还想第二天带着水枪来。这是她的个人体验；课文里说的三天也不能直接作为今天的活动日程。请问您想参与，还是只想了解现场气氛？如果希望保持衣服干燥，我们先询问您希望怎样观看，再核实现场能提供什么安排。介绍时也不必说参与以后就“像泰国人”，可以说越来越熟悉当地节日或越来越愿意交流。每个人都有选择参与程度的权利，不需要通过某一种活动来证明自己的文化理解。
successCriteria: Describe a trend without inventing live conditions.
Offer a genuine participation choice.
Reframe identity language thoughtfully.

tasks.title: Participation without pressure
tasks.prompt: Visitor: curious about Songkran but want to stay dry. Adviser: describe the source and ask what level of involvement they want. Round two: someone in the group assumes everyone will join; negotiate. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

discussion.prompt: Who intends to give which gift? How does 把 foreground the object?
discussion.guide: 佳佳 chooses chocolate and 素察 a flower basket; 把 places the specified object before its action/outcome.

patterns.title: Subject + 把 + object + verb + outcome
patterns.explanation: The source 把 examples foreground a specific object and what happens to it. Outcomes include location (放在/放到), recipient (交给/送给) and transformation (翻译成/切成). The source’s location-change summary is narrower than its own examples.
patterns.pitfall: Do not end the target exercise with a bare verb such as 把花篮送; state the relevant destination/recipient/result. Other 把 constructions exist beyond this lesson.
patterns.application: Write an event handover naming object, action and recipient.

patterns.title: 送给 / 表示感谢 / 一盒
patterns.explanation: 送给 identifies a gift recipient; 表示感谢 states purpose/meaning. 盒 counts boxed items in the gift example.
examples: 我把花送给老师，表示感谢。
我想把这盒巧克力送给老师。
patterns.pitfall: 送 can also mean deliver or accompany in other source examples. Resolve meaning from context.
patterns.application: Explain a gift’s intended recipient and meaning.

patterns.title: 给: compare source uses carefully
patterns.explanation: Slide 8 includes recipient, beneficiary, 向-like and colloquial passive examples. These are different constructions. The core task uses 送给 + recipient; the colloquial 芒果给丽丽吃了 is recognition-only extension, not a pattern to generalize to formal writing.
patterns.pitfall: 给 is not always the lexical verb “give”. Explain its role before translating.
patterns.application: Compare recipient and beneficiary uses; ask the teacher about the passive example.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, compare the recipient outcome and transformation outcome in two source 把 examples. Explain why the original summary needs extending.
tasks.model: “把作业交给老师”说明物品交到谁手里，“把汉语翻译成英语”则说明语言发生转化，不只是位置移动。因此，解释把字句时应该说清楚动作后的结果，不能把所有例子都归为地点改变。

tasks.title: A ceremony briefing and handover
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters in two parts: a visitor introduction to the source gratitude ceremony and an internal gift handover. Attribute customs to the source, preserve each giver’s gift, use two 把 sentences with clear outcomes and offer an alternative to physical participation.
tasks.model:
来宾介绍：课文中的拜师节活动用行礼和赠礼来表达感谢，也描述老师说祝福的话。这些是材料中的仪式情景，具体学校的安排和个人意愿可能不同。如果您希望只了解、不做动作，可以先向负责老师说明，也可以用口头或书面方式表达感谢，不必接受自己不愿意的身体接触。
内部交接：课文里佳佳准备把这盒巧克力送给老师，素察准备把这个花篮送给老师。请先核对礼物与赠送人的对应关系，再确认交给哪位老师。不要只写“把礼物送”，而要写清对象、动作和接收人，完成以后再向负责同事确认。
successCriteria: Respectfully attribute ceremony content and participation choices.
Preserve each gift’s giver and recipient.
Use 把 with an explicit outcome.

交接：请把…送给…
先核对…，完成后…

tasks.title: A gift handover and a participation question
tasks.prompt: Coordinator: confirm the two source gifts and their intended recipient. Visitor: ask whether a ceremony gesture is compulsory. Round two: one gift is assigned to the wrong giver; repair the handover. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

discussion.prompt: How does 但是 modify the permission? What is its exact scope?

patterns.title: 请不要 + verb phrase
patterns.explanation: 不要 expresses a prohibition or discouragement in the source examples. 请 can make delivery more courteous, but the scope of the instruction still matters.
patterns.pitfall: The source’s shoe instruction concerns entering 佛殿, not every space on every temple site. Confirm the site-specific instruction.
patterns.application: Give a clear instruction and a respectful next step without inventing a rule.

patterns.title: 以前 / 现在 / 以后；但是
patterns.explanation: Time expressions distinguish before, now and later. 但是 introduces a contrast or limitation; in the source permission exchange it adds a condition to 可以.
examples: 我以前是老师，现在是导游。
可以，但是请不要穿鞋进佛殿。
patterns.pitfall: A visitor’s earlier experience does not establish the present site’s rules.
patterns.application: Compare a previous impression with a present enquiry.

patterns.title: 以前…过吗？ / 发现…
patterns.explanation: 以前…过吗？ asks about prior experience; 发现 introduces something noticed. A personal observation does not establish an exhaustive cultural fact.
examples: 我发现泰国有很多寺庙。
patterns.pitfall: A description of Buddhism in the source does not define every individual’s beliefs.
patterns.application: Ask about previous experience, then invite a specific question.

tasks.title: Interpret with evidence
tasks.prompt: In 70–110 Chinese characters, explain the instruction’s scope and why a guide should ask rather than assume a visitor’s needs or beliefs.
tasks.model: 课文说“请不要穿鞋进佛殿”，范围是进入佛殿，不等于整个寺庙或泰国所有地方。导游应该说明具体地点和行为，询问游客是否有需要协助的地方，也不能从国籍推断对方的信仰或参观习惯。
successCriteria: Interpret instruction scope accurately.
Explain a respectful enquiry instead of an assumption.
scaffold: Quote a short source phrase, then explain what it shows.
Separate a statement from an inference or an unanswered question.
tasks.challenge: Capstone: write a 350–450-character visitor journey from arrival to a cultural visit. Use language from at least four lessons, include a misunderstanding and repair, and attach a short source/extension map.

tasks.title: A considerate cultural-site briefing
tasks.prompt: Write 160–240 Chinese characters for visitors before entering the source site. Ask about previous experience, explain the precise source shoe instruction, distinguish verified wording from questions for site staff, and offer a respectful enquiry route if someone cannot follow the physical instruction. Include 不要 and 但是.
tasks.model: 参观前提醒：请问您以前来过泰国或参观过类似的文化场所吗？课文里的目的地是查龙寺，进入佛殿时有“请不要穿鞋”的提醒。这里说的是具体的进入行为，不应该扩大成整个寺庙每个地方都一样的规则。我们可以先说明参观范围，但是实际开放区域和现场要求仍要向工作人员确认。如果您有不方便脱鞋或需要协助的情况，可以告诉我们希望怎样参观，我们再询问现场是否有合适的方式，不替对方作保证。了解礼节的目的是让交流更清楚、更尊重个人，而不是根据国籍推断信仰或要求大家有同样的感受。
successCriteria: Specify place, behavior and scope accurately.
Use a courteous instruction with a clarification route.
Respect needs without inventing permission or facilities.

请不要…，但是…
如果您不方便…，我们先询问…

tasks.title: A rule enquiry with a real concern
tasks.prompt: Guide: introduce the source site and explain the worship-hall instruction. Visitor: have a practical difficulty with the requested action. Round two: ask whether the rule applies outdoors too. Clarify scope and what must be checked with site staff. Perform for 2–3 minutes, then switch roles. In round two introduce the changed constraint. Save an 80–140-character transcript excerpt or reflection. A partner or teacher supplies live listening; the app does not record speech or assess pronunciation.

culturalNotes.title: Source context & editorial judgement
culturalNotes.text: Photography, fees, access and clothing examples are source teaching situations, not verified universal rules. Do not extend one hall instruction to all spaces. Religious identity and physical participation are personal.

issues: All selectable text, tables, notes, cached charts and supported embedded images extracted. Full visual interpretation and source answer-key checking remain for teacher review.
New tasks, English glosses and grammar explanations are editorial adaptations, not teacher-approved.

pedagogy.profile: Read the original Chinese first. Skip pinyin unless useful; invest effort in inference, coherent responses and audience. Use the speaking round to diagnose fluency separately from reading.
pedagogy.diagnostic: Explain the difference between a source instruction about entering a worship hall and a rule claimed for every temple space.

sequence.activity: Interpret instruction scope accurately.
Clarify the scope of a rule and a visitor’s concern.
Specify place, behavior and scope accurately.

decisions.content: Original dialogues, the complete source word lists, central patterns and cultural material remain accessible in their original sequence.
In 70–110 Chinese characters, explain the instruction’s scope and why a guide should ask rather than assume a visitor’s needs or beliefs.
Optional source Thai/pinyin, contextual chunks and task-specific sentence openings; spoken and written performance receive separate teacher feedback.
New evidence, vocabulary, grammar and communication checks have independent authored answer keys. Original exercise displays are retained; unverified answer-to-blank mappings are not auto-scored.

pedagogy.multilingual: Optional: compare one useful expression with Thai, German, English or Dutch. Explain a difference in word order or register, then return to Chinese. Your languages are resources, not translation homework.
pedagogy.reflection: Which task-specific criterion improved after revision? Quote a Chinese phrase, identify one remaining difficulty, and choose a next practice step.

instructions: Work with a partner or teacher; no recording is supplied or captured. Listener closes the Reading section.
Partner reads the first original dialogue twice, without adding facts. First listen for the purpose; then note details.
Listener answers the focus question below and asks one clarification in Chinese. Reopen Reading to compare against the source. Swap roles.
liveListening.focus: What does 小爱 say about visiting Thailand?
liveListening.assessment: Teacher checks comprehension and response to clarification from live evidence. Reading fluency does not substitute for listening evidence.

objectives: Interpret a guest's arrival constraints and reservation details.
Use 先…再… and conditional language to give a clear plan.
Write a professional reply without promising unconfirmed services.
goals: Clarify a booking and offer a conditional solution.
Prepare a guest-facing arrival message.

vocabulary.example: 请问您的预订是以谁的名字登记的？

gloss.th: จอง; การจอง

vocabulary.example: 您可以先寄存行李，下午再办理入住。

gloss.th: ดำเนินการเช็กอิน

vocabulary.example: 如果房间还没准备好，我们可以帮您寄存行李。

gloss.th: ฝากสัมภาระ

如果您有特殊需求，请提前告诉我们。

readings.title: A message before arrival
readings.context: Fictional training scenario. These hotel arrangements apply only to this exercise.
body: 客人：您好！我们明天上午十点左右到酒店，带着两位老人。请问能提前入住吗？预订人是林女士，共两间双床房。另外，我们想住得安静一些。
前台：林女士，您好！我们通常下午三点开始办理入住。能否提前入住，需视当天的房态而定。您到店后，我们可以先为您寄存行李，再确认房间是否准备好。关于安静的房间，我们已记录您的需求，但还需要当天确认。请问两位老人是否还有其他需要我们提前了解的需求？

patterns.title: 先…再… · sequence with a purpose
patterns.explanation: 先 introduces the first action and 再 the next. In service communication, a clear sequence reduces uncertainty. Put the guest's next step first.
examples: 您可以先寄存行李，再到休息区等候。
我们先确认预订，再为您安排房间。

patterns.title: 如果…，就… · state the condition
patterns.explanation: Use 如果 for a condition. 就 can link the result; it is sometimes omitted. Distinguish a confirmed arrangement from a conditional possibility.
examples: 如果房间已经准备好，我们就为您办理入住。
如果您需要帮助，请联系前台。

questions.prompt: What does the receptionist actually confirm?

options.text: Both rooms will be ready at 10 a.m.
The hotel can store luggage and has recorded the quiet-room request.
The guests will receive a room upgrade.

questions.explanation: The reply confirms luggage storage and a recorded request. Early check-in and a quiet room still require confirmation.

questions.prompt: Why ask about the older guests' needs?

options.text: Age alone determines every service they need.
To discover individual needs without making assumptions.

questions.explanation: Ask the guests about their needs. Do not infer mobility, health or preferences from age alone.

questions.prompt: Complete the sequence: 我们先确认预订，____为您安排房间。
questions.explanation: 再 introduces the next action after 先; 在 marks location or an action in progress.

questions.prompt: Choose the most professional response to an unconfirmed early check-in request.

options.text: 我们会尽力安排，但需要视当天的房态而定。

questions.explanation: Acknowledge the request and state the condition clearly. Avoid a guarantee you cannot verify.

tasks.title: Write the arrival reply
tasks.prompt: In Chinese, write 140–220 characters to a guest arriving at 10 a.m. with a quiet-room request. For this fictional hotel, standard check-in is 3 p.m. and luggage storage is available. Acknowledge both requests, explain what is conditional, offer a clear next step and ask one useful question.
scaffold: 林女士，您好！感谢您…
您可以先…，再…
关于…，我们已记录，但…
请问您是否…？
tasks.challenge: Offer a useful alternative while preserving guest choice. Explain why your wording avoids an unrealistic promise.
tasks.model: 林女士，您好！感谢您提前告知到店时间。我们通常下午三点开始办理入住。您上午十点到店后，可以先寄存行李，我们再为您确认房间是否准备好。提前入住及安静房间的安排都需要视当天的房态而定，目前还无法保证。我们已经记录您的需求，会尽力协调。如果暂时不能入住，您可以先到休息区等候。请问两位老人是否有需要提前告知我们的具体需求？

tasks.title: At the reception desk
tasks.prompt: With a partner acting as the guest, perform a 2-minute exchange. Confirm the reservation, clarify one need and explain a conditional arrangement. Save a short Chinese transcript or a reflection after speaking. This app does not record or recognize speech.
scaffold: Ask the guest to clarify one detail.
Paraphrase the request before offering a solution.
Close by confirming the agreed next step.
tasks.challenge: Your partner changes their request halfway through. Adapt without losing a professional tone.
tasks.model: Receptionist: 请问我理解得对吗？您希望两间房都比较安静，而且最好能提前入住。Guest: 对，不过如果不能提前入住，我们可以先寄存行李。Receptionist: 好的，我先确认您的预订，再查看房态。

supplementary.title: 把行程交给客人选择
supplementary.subtitle: Recommend with reasons
objectives: Compare options against a guest's stated priorities.
Use 与其…不如… and 不仅…还… appropriately.
Write a justified itinerary with a realistic contingency.
goals: Recommend without assuming everyone's preferences are the same.
Prepare an itinerary and explain its tradeoffs to a guest.
supplementary.hospitality: Prepare an itinerary and explain its tradeoffs to a guest.

vocabulary.example: 我们可以根据您的兴趣调整行程。

gloss.th: กำหนดการเดินทาง

vocabulary.example: 请问您对活动有什么偏好？
如果下雨，我们还有室内的备选方案。
我们会根据您的预算推荐活动。
出发前还需要确认交通情况。

gloss.th: การเดินทาง; การจราจร

vocabulary.example: 这份行程比较灵活，可以随时调整。

readings.title: Two options, one guest
readings.context: Fictional options for comparison; prices, times and places are not travel advice.
body: 客人留言：我们只有一个下午，预算是每人八百泰铢以内。我们喜欢了解当地生活，不想一直坐车。如果下雨，最好也有活动可以参加。
方案甲：步行参观社区，参加室内手工体验。预计三小时，每人七百泰铢。步行约二十分钟，可根据天气减少户外部分。
方案乙：乘车参观三个海边景点。预计四小时，每人九百泰铢，其中约两小时在车上。下雨时部分户外活动可能取消。

patterns.title: 与其…不如… · recommend an alternative
patterns.explanation: Use 与其 A，不如 B to suggest B as preferable to A. Give a reason tied to the guest's priorities; do not dismiss their preferences.
examples: 与其把时间都花在路上，不如选择附近的活动。

patterns.title: 不仅…还… · add a relevant benefit
patterns.explanation: 不仅…还… links two benefits or facts. Keep both clauses parallel and make each benefit relevant to the audience.
examples: 这个方案不仅符合预算，还能让您了解当地生活。

questions.prompt: Which recommendation uses the strongest evidence?

options.text: Plan B, because more attractions always mean a better trip.
Plan A, because it fits the budget, limits travel and has an indoor option.
Plan B, because rain never affects transport.

questions.explanation: Plan A meets the stated constraints. Plan B exceeds the budget and includes long vehicle travel.

questions.prompt: What should still be checked before booking Plan A?

options.text: Whether spaces and the quoted arrangements are available for their date.
Whether every guest from their country likes handicrafts.
Nothing: an exercise description guarantees availability.

questions.explanation: Confirm real availability and current conditions before booking; a recommendation is not a reservation.

questions.prompt: Complete: 这个方案不仅符合预算，____能让您了解当地生活。
questions.explanation: 还 adds the second relevant benefit after 不仅.

questions.prompt: Which question best personalizes the recommendation?

options.text: 你们国家的人不是都喜欢海边吗？
您更想体验手工活动，还是在社区里散步？

questions.explanation: Ask about this guest's preferences rather than assigning preferences to a nationality.

tasks.title: A guest-ready afternoon plan
tasks.prompt: Use the fictional guest brief and Plan A to write a 160–240-character Chinese recommendation. Justify your choice using at least two constraints, give a sequence, explain a rain alternative, and ask one question before booking. Do not invent extra attractions or confirmed reservations.
scaffold: 根据您的预算和兴趣，我建议…
与其…，不如…
如果下雨，可以…
预订前，请问…？
tasks.challenge: Discuss one limitation of your preferred option and offer a choice without pressure.
tasks.model: 根据您的预算和兴趣，我建议选择方案甲。每人七百泰铢，符合八百泰铢以内的预算；活动约三小时，不会占用整个下午。您可以先步行参观社区，再参加室内手工体验。与其把很多时间花在车上，不如在附近了解当地生活。如果下雨，我们可以减少户外部分，并先确认室内活动是否有空位。不过，方案甲仍需要步行约二十分钟。预订前，请问您对步行和手工体验有什么偏好？

tasks.title: Make your recommendation
tasks.prompt: Give a 90-second Chinese recommendation to a partner. Invite a question and revise one part of the plan. Save the final recommendation or your reflection.
scaffold: State the recommendation first.
Use details from the brief as evidence.
Ask whether the proposal fits the guest's priorities.
tasks.challenge: Respond when your partner says they dislike handicrafts.
tasks.model: 我推荐方案甲，主要因为它符合您的预算，而且乘车时间少。不过，手工体验是否适合您，还需要听听您的意见。

supplementary.title: 把投诉变成解决方案
supplementary.subtitle: Service recovery, with care
objectives: Separate the guest's problem from unverified assumptions.
Use 由于…因此… and 尽管…还是… in a service response.
Offer bounded solutions and confirm follow-up.
goals: Acknowledge inconvenience and negotiate a practical solution.
Write a service recovery message with a clear follow-up.
supplementary.hospitality: Write a service recovery message with a clear follow-up.

vocabulary.example: 给您带来不便，我们深表歉意。

gloss.th: ความไม่สะดวก

vocabulary.example: 我会与相关同事协调，尽快回复您。
我们正在处理噪音问题。
我会在十五分钟后再次与您联系，跟进处理情况。
关于补偿，我需要先向主管确认。
我们希望与您一起确认合适的解决方案。

gloss.th: แนวทางแก้ไข

readings.title: A room that is too noisy
readings.context: Fictional service constraints: another room is not yet confirmed; the receptionist must ask a supervisor about compensation.
body: 客人：昨晚走廊一直有噪音，我几乎没睡。我已经告诉前台一次了，但没有人回复。明天我还要很早出发。
值班记录：请先了解噪音发生的时间与位置，并向客人道歉。可以联系值班同事处理现场情况。是否有安静的空房需要核实；补偿须由主管确认。请与客人约定下次联系的时间，并记录处理结果。

patterns.title: 由于…因此… · cause and consequence
patterns.explanation: 由于 introduces a cause; 因此 introduces its result. In a complaint response, explain a constraint briefly after acknowledging the impact. A cause should not become an excuse.
examples: 由于换房需要先核实房态，因此目前还无法确认。

patterns.title: 尽管…，还是… · acknowledge a contrast
patterns.explanation: 尽管 introduces a known fact; 还是 introduces a result that persists despite it. Compare with 如果, which introduces a condition that may or may not occur.
examples: 尽管我们已经联系了相关同事，还是需要再次确认处理结果。

questions.prompt: What makes this complaint more serious than noise alone?

options.text: The guest has already reported it and received no follow-up.
The guest asks for a luxury suite.
The guest has confirmed the source of the noise.

questions.explanation: The failure to reply has damaged trust. A response should address both the disturbance and the missed follow-up.

questions.prompt: Which action is within the stated authority?

options.text: Guarantee a room is available before checking.
Contact the duty team and agree a follow-up time.

questions.explanation: The record permits coordination and follow-up. Room changes need checking and compensation needs supervisor confirmation.

questions.prompt: Complete: ____我们已经联系了相关同事，还是需要再次确认处理结果。
questions.explanation: 尽管 introduces a concession about something that has already happened.

questions.prompt: Choose the most appropriate opening.

options.text: 很抱歉噪音影响了您的休息，也很抱歉之前没有及时回复。

questions.explanation: Acknowledge the specific impact and the missed response without blaming the guest.

tasks.title: Restore trust in writing
tasks.prompt: Write a 160–240-character Chinese reply. Acknowledge both problems, ask one clarifying question, offer only actions permitted by the duty record, and propose a specific follow-up time as your training plan. Do not guarantee compensation or an unverified room change.
scaffold: 很抱歉…，也很抱歉…
为了尽快处理，请问…？
我会先…，并…
我将在…再次与您联系。
tasks.challenge: The guest insists on an immediate refund. Explain the approval boundary while maintaining empathy.
tasks.model: 很抱歉走廊的噪音影响了您的休息，也很抱歉您之前反映后没有得到及时回复。我们理解您明天需要早起，希望尽快改善您的休息环境。请问噪音主要发生在什么时间、靠近哪个位置？我会立即联系值班同事处理，并为您核实是否有更安静的空房。目前还不能保证换房，补偿方案也需要主管确认。我将在十五分钟后再次与您联系，告知处理进展；如果仍未解决，我们会继续协调下一步安排。

tasks.title: Handle the follow-up call
tasks.prompt: Role-play a 2-minute follow-up call with a partner. The noise has reduced but the guest is still dissatisfied. Confirm the impact, summarize the action taken and agree the next step. Save a transcript or reflection.
scaffold: Check whether the situation has improved.
Acknowledge what remains unresolved.
Confirm who will do what next.
tasks.challenge: Your partner interrupts twice. Use a respectful clarification strategy.
tasks.model: 请问现在的噪音是否有所减轻？我理解您仍然担心今晚的休息。我会继续核实房态，并在约定时间前回复您。

supplementary.title: 用提问代替猜测
supplementary.subtitle: Hospitality across cultures
objectives: Interpret an individual request without cultural stereotypes.
Use 是否 and 以便 to clarify needs respectfully.
Write a service note that shares only necessary information.
goals: Ask about dietary and access preferences without making guarantees.
Create a concise guest-facing reply and an internal handover.
supplementary.hospitality: Create a concise guest-facing reply and an internal handover.

vocabulary.example: 请问您有什么需要我们提前了解的饮食要求？

gloss.th: ข้อกำหนดด้านอาหาร

vocabulary.example: 我会先与厨房确认食材。
请问这是个人偏好，还是与过敏有关？
我们需要先确认无障碍设施的具体情况。

gloss.th: ที่เอื้อต่อการเข้าถึง

vocabulary.example: 征得您的同意后，我们会把相关需求转告厨房。

gloss.th: ขอความยินยอม

vocabulary.example: 交接时只记录服务所需的信息。

readings.title: Ask the individual
readings.context: Fictional training scenario. No food safety or access assurance is implied. Staff must verify with the responsible team.
body: 客人：我们周五入住，其中一位不吃花生。家人走路时间长了容易累。我们希望先了解用餐和出行的安排，不想给大家添麻烦。
服务提醒：不要根据客人的国籍、语言或外貌推测饮食与行动需求。先询问具体要求和个人偏好，再与负责同事核实。食材、制作过程和无障碍设施都不能在未确认前作保证。转交个人需求前，应征得客人同意；交接记录只保留服务所需的信息。

patterns.title: 是否 · ask a neutral yes/no question
patterns.explanation: 是否 means whether. It is useful in formal enquiries. Keep sensitive questions relevant, offer the guest a choice, and avoid pressuring them to disclose unnecessary details.
examples: 请问您是否愿意让我们把相关需求转告厨房？

patterns.title: 以便 · explain the purpose
patterns.explanation: 以便 introduces an intended purpose: so that / in order to. Explaining why you ask for information makes a service request clearer.
examples: 请告诉我们您的具体需求，以便我们与相关同事确认安排。

questions.prompt: Which detail remains uncertain?

options.text: Avoiding peanuts is a preference or relates to an allergy.
One family member gets tired after long walks.

questions.explanation: The message says only 不吃花生. Ask for clarification and verify with the kitchen; do not infer an allergy or guarantee safety.

questions.prompt: Which internal note is most appropriate after receiving consent?

options.text: A stereotype based on the guest's nationality.
A detailed medical history unrelated to the service.
The confirmed service requirement and the team responsible for checking it.

questions.explanation: Keep only necessary information and identify who will verify it. Guest needs should not become an excuse for collecting unrelated personal information.

questions.prompt: Complete: 请告诉我们您的具体需求，____我们与相关同事确认安排。
questions.explanation: 以便 introduces the purpose of asking for the information.

questions.prompt: Which reply respects the guest's autonomy?

options.text: 我们已经替您决定，您不用说了。
请问您更希望减少步行，还是在途中安排休息？
像您这样的人都需要轮椅。

questions.explanation: Offer a relevant choice and ask what works for this guest. Do not assume what support they want.

tasks.title: A thoughtful reply and handover
tasks.prompt: Write two short Chinese texts, 160–240 characters in total: a reply to the guest and an internal handover note. Ask a neutral dietary clarification, offer a choice about walking, request consent to share necessary information and identify what must still be verified. Do not promise allergen-free food or access facilities.
scaffold: 为了…，请问…？
您更希望…，还是…？
征得您的同意后，我们会…
待确认：…；负责同事：…
tasks.challenge: Explain in English which personal details you deliberately left out of the handover and why.
tasks.model:
客人回复：您好！感谢您提前告知需求。为了与厨房确认安排，请问不吃花生是个人偏好，还是与过敏有关？我们需要核实食材及制作情况，暂时还不能作出保证。关于出行，您更希望减少步行，还是途中安排休息？征得您的同意后，我们会把相关需求转告负责同事。
交接记录：客人周五入住。待确认饮食要求、厨房安排及减少步行的可选方案。仅在客人同意后转交必要信息，由餐饮与前台同事分别核实并回复。

tasks.title: Listen, clarify, confirm
tasks.prompt: Conduct a 2-minute needs conversation with a partner. Ask open questions, summarize the preferences in Chinese, and obtain consent before handing over. Save a transcript or a reflection on how your questions avoided assumptions.
scaffold: Start with the guest's own description.
Confirm your understanding.
Explain who needs the information and why.
tasks.challenge: The guest does not want to share further details. Respect that choice and explain what you can still check.
tasks.model: 我想确认一下：您希望减少连续步行的时间，但不需要我们替您决定所有安排，对吗？如果您同意，我会请负责同事核实可选择的休息地点。
